business.title: What kind of business is this?
business.description: e.g. 'a three-person electrical contractor', 'a café in Portland'.

currency.title: Which currency are the books kept in?
currency.description: A three-letter code, e.g. USD, EUR or GBP.

tools.name: books_status
tools.description: Last month's P&L (income, cost of jobs, gross and net profit by category), the month-close checklist with the steps still to do, receipts waiting in the inbox, and entries that need a category, each with its id. Call it first for any question about the books.

tools.name: record_entry
tools.description: Book money in or out: payee, amount in ordinary units (e.g. 284.17), date (YYYY-MM-DD), category, and the receipt's inbox path when there is one. The same receipt, or the same payee, date and amount, updates the entry instead of adding it twice. Call it as soon as a payment, sale or receipt is mentioned, before you describe it. When the category is unclear, leave it out and ask.

tools.name: categorize_entry
tools.description: Give an entry its category, or change it, found by id or payee. Call it the moment the person says what a charge was for.

tools.name: tick_close_step
tools.description: Check off a month-close step for the month being closed: bank, card, payroll, income, review, or receipts (when the leftover inbox files are set aside). Call it as soon as the person says a step is done.

tools.name: close_month
tools.description: Close a finished month once every step on its checklist is done; its entries are then locked. If steps are left, the error names them.

tools.name: reopen_month
tools.description: Reopen a closed month so an entry in it can be fixed. Close it again afterward.

tools.name: list_entries
tools.description: Every entry for a month (YYYY-MM), with ids, payees, amounts, categories and receipts.
